description: Cases every renderer of the generic kinds reproduces. For each case, decode files (text is UTF-8; base64 is raw bytes), use the registry's caps with the case's caps in their place, build the model of view, and compare it with model: numbers by binary64 equality that tells -0 from 0 (Object.is), texts exactly. snaps give the row a pointer at x reads, and locates the bin that holds a value (-1 underflow, the bin count overflow). Each refusal's view is refused with word, nothing is drawn, and downloads lists the files still offered.

cases.name: sensor_field_integer_maps
cases.covers: Integer value columns are maps too, read under the integer grammar.

cases.name: sensor_field_types_eeg_only
cases.covers: Rows typed EEG, EOG and ECG and one untyped: with any row typed, only the EEG rows are drawn (16 of 19).

cases.name: sensor_field_types_folded
cases.covers: A type's letters are folded as sensor-labels folds them: eeg, Eeg and EEG are all EEG, and every row is drawn.

cases.name: sensor_field_untyped
cases.covers: A sensor_type column of n/a and empty cells: no row is typed, so every row is drawn.

cases.name: sensor_field_no_eeg_sensors
cases.covers: Every row typed, none EEG (EMG): no_eeg_sensors in every map's place.

cases.name: sensor_field_positions
cases.covers: Measured positions (CapTrak, meters) projected by nemar.sensor-layout.v1: the model holds the stored x, y and z.

cases.name: sensor_field_positions_no_place
cases.covers: n/a in a position's x: that row has no place, and the rest are fitted and drawn.

cases.name: sensor_field_positions_template
cases.covers: Template positions from standard_1005 (n/a, montage): projected about the montage's own center.

cases.name: sensor_field_positions_eeg_and_seeg
cases.covers: Scalp EEG beside a depth shaft (SEEG) in one positions file: the SEEG rows are never drawn, and the projection fits the EEG rows alone.

cases.name: sensor_field_positions_fit_eeg_rows
cases.covers: Flat scalp positions (z = 0) beside depth contacts typed SEEG that lie off their plane: the projection fits the EEG rows alone, which are flat, so the sensors are placed by name (a fit through every row would have found a sphere).

cases.name: sensor_field_positions_flat_names
cases.covers: Measured positions on one plane (z = 0): positions_flat, so the sensors are placed by name on standard_1005 instead, and the model says why the positions were not used.

cases.name: sensor_field_positions_frame_unknown_names
cases.covers: Positions in the coordinate system Other: frame_unknown, placed by name.

cases.name: sensor_field_positions_flat_names_refused
cases.covers: Flat positions whose names match no montage: the names are refused (labels_unrecognized), and that is every map's word.

cases.name: sensor_field_implant_acpc
cases.covers: An intracranial implant (SEEG shafts, an ECOG strip named C1 to C6, a DBS lead) in ACPC: frame_not_scalp, never drawn as a scalp map and never placed by its names.

cases.name: sensor_field_pixels
cases.covers: Positions in Pixels (a photograph of a grid, z n/a): frame_not_scalp.

cases.name: sensor_field_names
cases.covers: No sensor role: the names in the values file are placed by nemar.sensor-labels.v1 on standard_1005 (template positions).

cases.name: sensor_field_names_on_columns
cases.covers: Sensors along the columns, named by the header; one map per row, labeled by the column band.

cases.name: sensor_field_maps_by_row_number
cases.covers: Sensors along the columns and no second dimension: each map is labeled by its row number, from 1.

cases.name: sensor_field_names_some_unplaced
cases.covers: Names with an EOG and a trigger channel among them: sensor-labels places the 19 scalp names, and the two it leaves unplaced are not drawn.

cases.name: sensor_field_names_refused
cases.covers: Names that match no montage: labels_unrecognized in every map's place.

cases.name: sensor_field_names_too_few
cases.covers: Seven names: sensor-labels refuses them first (too_few_channels).

cases.name: sensor_field_one_map_overflows
cases.covers: Three maps on one layout; the second's values overflow the interpolation (interpolation_failed) and the others are drawn.

cases.name: sensor_field_too_few_sensors
cases.covers: A layout of seven sensors: every map too_few_sensors (a map needs 8).

cases.name: sensor_field_head_outside_grid
cases.covers: A sensor at radius 1e10 stretches the grid past the head: head_outside_grid in every map's place.

cases.name: sensor_field_values_ragged
cases.covers: The values file has a ragged row: tsv_ragged.

cases.name: sensor_field_values_column_missing
cases.covers: A declared map column the header lacks: column_missing.

cases.name: sensor_field_values_value_type
cases.covers: A value column declared string: value_type.

cases.name: sensor_field_values_units_differ
cases.covers: Maps in uV and in dB: value_units_differ.

cases.name: sensor_field_values_empty
cases.covers: A header and no rows (and a layout of none): empty.

cases.name: sensor_field_values_n_a
cases.covers: n/a in a map's values: cell_not_number (only a place may be n/a).

cases.name: sensor_field_values_not_finite
cases.covers: A value 1e400: cell_not_finite.

cases.name: sensor_field_values_not_integer
cases.covers: 2.5 in an integer map: cell_not_integer.

cases.name: sensor_field_values_rows_cap
cases.covers: Nineteen sensor rows over caps.entries_per_dim 18: cap_exceeded.

cases.name: sensor_field_maps_header_on_rows
cases.covers: A maps dimension along the rows that names the header: coords_unresolved (a header names columns).

cases.name: sensor_field_names_coords_mismatch
cases.covers: The values' name column declared integer, the sensor dimension string: coords_mismatch.

cases.name: sensor_field_layout_short
cases.covers: A layout of 18 rows for 19 sensor rows: coords_length.

cases.name: sensor_field_layout_long
cases.covers: A layout of 19 rows for 18 sensor rows: coords_length.

cases.name: sensor_field_positions_short
cases.covers: Positions of 18 rows for 19 sensor rows: coords_length.

cases.name: sensor_field_layout_line_endings
cases.covers: A layout with CRLF line endings: tsv_line_endings.

cases.name: sensor_field_layout_column_missing
cases.covers: The layout declares radius, and its header calls it rad: column_missing.

cases.name: sensor_field_layout_column_repeated
cases.covers: The layout declares sensor_type twice: column_repeated.

cases.name: sensor_field_layout_cells_cap
cases.covers: Nineteen layout rows of three declared columns are 57 cells, over 56: cap_exceeded (the values hold 38).

cases.name: sensor_field_layout_not_a_number
cases.covers: A theta NA (not n/a): cell_not_number.

cases.name: sensor_field_layout_not_finite
cases.covers: A radius 1e400: cell_not_finite.

cases.name: sensor_field_positions_not_a_number
cases.covers: A position nan: cell_not_number.

cases.name: order_sensor_coordinate_before_values
cases.covers: The name column declared integer and a value column declared string: coords_mismatch.

cases.name: order_sensor_values_cells_before_layout
cases.covers: n/a in the values and a layout one row short: the values' cells come first, cell_not_number.

cases.name: order_sensor_layout_grammar_before_columns
cases.covers: A ragged layout whose header calls radius rad: tsv_ragged.

cases.name: order_sensor_layout_repeated_before_missing
cases.covers: sensor_type declared twice, and radius missing from the header: column_repeated.

cases.name: order_sensor_layout_missing_before_length
cases.covers: radius missing from the header, and the layout a row short: column_missing.

cases.name: order_sensor_layout_length_before_cap
cases.covers: The layout a row short, and over the cap on cells: coords_length.

cases.name: order_sensor_layout_cap_before_cells
cases.covers: The layout over the cap on cells, with a theta NA: cap_exceeded.

cases.name: order_sensor_layout_column_by_column
cases.covers: A theta 1e400 in the last row and a radius x in the first, theta declared first: the cells are read column by column, cell_not_finite.

cases.name: order_sensor_files_before_frame
cases.covers: A layout in ACPC with a theta NA: the files come first, so the view falls back with cell_not_number rather than showing frame_not_scalp.

cases.name: order_sensor_frame_before_types
cases.covers: A layout in ACPC whose rows are all typed SEEG: frame_not_scalp.
